title: mdm.exchange_rate.published.v1
description: An exchange rate's complete current state, published when it is entered or corrected; the record ID is its UUIDv7. One rate per type, date and pair. Also the data of SourceService for AGGREGATE_EXCHANGE_RATE.

rate.description: one unit of from_currency in to_currency; positive, at most 10 decimal places, no trailing zeros

source.description: manual, or the rate source adapter that delivered it
